numerical_recomputation.notes: The deterministic calculation is an ideal upper bound only; it includes no lock measurement, coherence, queueing, scheduling, NUMA, imbalance, memory, I/O, correctness or real-time effect.

evidence: Re-derived utilization approximation as arrival rate times expected hold time and the serial-fraction upper bound as one divided by the sum of serial and processor-divided parallel fractions.
